newsitem.title: BELGIUM: BELGIAN DE BILDE BANNED UNTIL MARCH 31.
newsitem.headline: BELGIAN DE BILDE BANNED UNTIL MARCH 31.

text.p: Belgium and Anderlecht striker Gilles De Bilde was banned from playing until March 31 on Wednesday for punching another player in the face, the Belgian soccer union said.
De Bilde was charged with assault and grievous bodily harm after striking Aalst player Krist Porte during the game on December 21.
Porte suffered a broken eye socket and nose.
De Bilde spent a night in jail after the incident and was suspended until further notice by both by his club and the soccer union.
He publicly apologised to Porte and Anderlecht fans in a prime-time television show last week.
Porte still stuffers from blurred vision and headaches and has to rest for at least two more weeks before undergoing any further treatment.
De Bilde, who moved to Anderlecht from Aalst in 1995 after turning down a lucrative offer from Atletico Madrid, became a national celebrity when he won the 1994 award for best Belgian league player.
Belgian media said earlier on Wednesday that leading Dutch club PSV Eindhoven were keen to sign De Bilde, regardless of whether he was suspended.
De Bilde, who felled Porte with a left hook in front of television cameras, faces trial for another alleged assault.
He allegedly struck two male nurses in August 1995 when he was denied access to his father in hospital.
